limits: Actual native evidence establishes that a non-STILL_ACTIVE exit code can precede kernel process signaling during DLL_PROCESS_DETACH. It does not identify the owner or cause of the historical Broker.exe sharing violation.
The before/after comparison uses controlled simulated Process objects; it proves the stop function cannot advance to its next file gate when the held-handle wait has not completed.
The fix adds a bounded completion wait on every selected retained process handle on the normal path before Dispose and the file gate; prior ownership/CIM/kill errors still fail.
No product process, installed package, registration, user setting, UI or installation was run or mutated by these tests. No input or physical acceptance is claimed.
Executable/DLL/PDB outputs are excluded. Sources, receipts and raw logs are retained byte-for-byte. Original cb77 18-case evidence is in the separate stop-race-regression-cb77b675 archive.
